# FG-CI-0011

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`ci-runner`](../../ops/runbooks/ci-runner.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `an_image_outside_the_allowed_registries_is_refused_before_any_call` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: CI のジョブのイメージは、この Runner で許可されたレジストリのものではありません。ジョブは実行されませんでした。
- en: The CI job's image is not from a registry this runner allows. The job was not run.
- id: Image tugas CI bukan dari registri yang diizinkan runner ini. Tugas tidak dijalankan.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C4 review: `forge-runner` runs only images whose name starts with one of the prefixes in its configuration's `image_registries` (the internal registry mirror, plan 14 §9.3). The claimed job's image is outside every prefix, so the job fails before any git call, pull or container.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The runner host (`journalctl -u forge-runner`, JSON) logs it once (warn) with `error_code`, `request_id` and in `context` `job_id`, `attempt`, `pipeline_id`, `project_id` and `image`; the job's log ends with the same code. Compare the image with `image_registries` in /etc/forge-runner/config.toml.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook ci-runner: mirror the image into the internal registry and change the job's `image` in `.forge-ci.yml` to the mirror (pinned by digest), or — after review — add the registry prefix to `image_registries` and restart the runner.
